item.title: BYD officially crushes Tesla in all-electric sales for 2025, secures global BEV crown
item.description: After years of trading quarterly blows, BYD has officially overtaken Tesla as the world’s largest manufacturer of all-electric vehicles (BEVs) for the full year of 2025. And it wasn’t even close. more…

item.title: Podcast: Tesla Q4 deliveries, BYD secures BEV crown, Cybercab spotted, and more
item.description: In the Electrek Podcast, we discuss the most popular news in the world of sustainable transport and energy. In this week’s episode, we discuss Tesla’s Q4 deliveries, BYD securing the BEV crown, the Cybercab being spotted, and more. more…

item.title: US offshore wind backlash grows as Empire, Revolution Wind sue Trump admin
item.description: Two more offshore wind developers are suing the Trump administration after it abruptly ordered construction to stop on offshore wind projects that were already nearing completion. more…

item.title: Hyundai and Kia win big with South Korea’s new support for EVs
item.description: Hyundai and Kia gained an edge over surging Chinese brands like BYD after South Korea raised subsidies and introduced additional policies to support EVs. more…

item.title: Solid-state EV batteries take another big step forward in China
item.description: China introduced its first national standard for solid-state EV batteries as the “holy grail” of battery tech moves closer toward mass production. more…

item.title: Connecticut puts EV chargers at the DMV – finally, a perk
item.description: Going to the DMV is never fun, but in Connecticut, at least your EV can now get a charge while you wait. more…

item.title: Sandvik bringing battery-swap mining rigs to Eldorado Gold mine
item.description: Canadian mining firm Eldorado Gold is taking a big step towards decarbonizing its operations with a fresh order for ten fully electric equipment assets from the experts at Sandvik set to be deployed later this year. more…

item.title: Vermeer soft-launches new line of electric tree care equipment
item.description: The equipment experts at Vermeer are jumping into the electric landscaping and forestry markets with both feet following the limited launch of three all-new, all-electric equipment options for the US and European markets. more…

item.title: Electric vehicles will end oil wars – if we let them
item.description: With the news of the US’ actions in Venezuela this morning, we are reminded again of how reducing oil demand can lead to less conflict – and electric vehicles are our best bet for doing so. more…

item.title: Success! High-speed wireless charging gets real at Purdue University
item.description: For the first time in the US, a battery-electric semi truck has successfully been charged at highway speeds, and without wires thanks to a new, patent-pending system designed by a team of Purdue University engineers with support from Cummins. more…
